description: Maya keeps the family's inherited sourdough starter and must make the final call about how it is divided, fed, stored, and used for a Saturday family brunch, with input from four relatives.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Sourdough Starter Keeper and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family has 300 grams of sourdough starter inherited from their grandmother.
shared_context.S2: The starter is being prepared for a Saturday family brunch at Maya's home.
shared_context.S3: Maya is deciding how the starter will be divided, refreshed, stored, and used.
shared_context.S4: Maya's usual pre-brunch routine is to check with everyone before she settles the kitchen plan.
shared_context.S5: The family wants to keep some starter going for future baking rather than using all of it at the brunch.

PF1.text: Jordan promised to bake two loaves for the brunch and needs exactly 90 grams of starter from Maya by Friday at 18:00.

PF2.text: Leah has celiac disease and cannot handle wheat flour or enter the kitchen during the starter preparation; she can participate remotely by choosing music and greeting guests.

PF3.text: A fermentation instructor named Nina Patel told Rosa that this starter should be refreshed at an exact 1:2:2 starter-to-water-to-flour ratio and refrigerated at 4 degrees Celsius after 8 hours.

PF4.text: Evan found a handwritten note from their grandmother asking the family to retain exactly 30 grams of the starter in the original jar for the next family baking day.

acceptance_conditions: Jordan must receive exactly 90 grams of starter.
Exactly 30 grams must be retained in the original jar.
The remaining 270 grams must be allocated among the four relatives.
Leah must participate remotely and have no kitchen contact.
The starter must be refreshed at a 1:2:2 ratio.
The refreshed starter must be refrigerated at 4 degrees Celsius after 8 hours.
A commitment must arrange Jordan's 90-gram handoff by Friday at 18:00.
A commitment must confirm Leah's remote-only, no-kitchen-contact participation.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'jordan_handoff' and c['detail'] == '90 grams by Friday 18:00' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'leah_remote_participation' and c['detail'] == 'remote only with no kitchen contact' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's promise changes his allocation from an ordinary share to exactly 90 grams and creates the handoff due by Friday at 18:00.
Leah's celiac disease changes her participation to remote-only with no kitchen contact and requires the matching safety commitment.
Nina Patel's recommendation changes the refresh from an unspecified method to the exact 1:2:2 ratio and changes storage to refrigeration at 4 degrees Celsius after 8 hours.
The grandmother's note changes the retained amount to exactly 30 grams in the original jar and supplies the private fact that must be cited by Maya.
